method.render_check: For non-singleton strict text groups, independently render every body page at72DPI and mask only the actual component-identifier header/footer span. Compare RGB pixel bytes. Does not execute code.
method.strict_group_boundary: Text equality alone removes whitespace; render equality corroborates body layout, code indentation, diagrams and tables at72DPI. Non-identical rendering retains uncertainty until reviewed.
method.data_check: Compare filename,role,SHA256 of all44provided TXT through Stage1 audit; evidence.doc and instructions PDF are excluded from executable data signature.

counting_contract.primary_reporting: Keep raw29paper /87question /672part /2175mark coverage. No source is removed, renamed or overwritten.
counting_contract.paper_incidence: For pattern P, count unique raw paper IDs containing at least one assessed P. Divide by29. Report context-only appearances separately.
counting_contract.question_incidence: Count unique (paper_id,Q1/Q2/Q3) containing at least one assessed P. Denominator87.
counting_contract.part_incidence: Count unique part_id assessed with P. Denominator672. Multi-tag rows can appear in multiple pattern rows.
counting_contract.marks_primary: Allocate each scored part once to its primary_pattern_id. Across primary patterns the total must equal2175. Allocation is editorial, not official split of marks among skills.
counting_contract.marks_assessed_union: For patternP sum marks once per unique assessed part_id. Across multi-tag pattern rows totals overlap and must not be added. For a set of patterns first union their part IDs, then sum marks.
counting_contract.strict_text_sensitivity: Collapse only within21strict_groups. Count group with P once if the corresponding reviewed members agree. Before representative selection verify per-part label/marks and assessed tags agree across group members; disagreement is a QA finding, not a reason to silently pick one variant.
counting_contract.render_conservative_sensitivity: Optional23groups preserve the two pairs whose body text matches but visible rendering differs. Useful if claiming facsimile identity would exceed evidence.
counting_contract.near_equivalence_note: w21/41,42 share intended output operation despite parentheses difference. Keep them separate for all authorized denominator views; do not publish20as an authoritative denominator.
counting_contract.group_part_denominators: For part/mark sensitivity use one reviewed representative per group with identical question/part labels and marks;21groups=487parts/1575marks,23groups=536parts/1725marks. Do not divide raw672parts or2175marks by group count.
counting_contract.classification_guard: Normalized text membership supports comparing proposed classifications, but glyph/format/context can differ. Never use this grouping as automatic verified-code deduplication.
counting_contract.frequency_language: Say appears in X of29paper files and Y of21normalized-body groups. Do not infer exam probability, causal independence, future coverage, or population frequency from this convenience corpus.
counting_contract.rare_evidence: Always print raw/group numerator and denominator; when only one group supports a pattern label it limited corpus evidence. Any additional rarity threshold is an explicit editorial choice, not a Cambridge fact.
